Common Window AC Issues We Fix Instantly

From minor tune-ups to major repairs, our window AC mechanic team has seen it all. Here are some common problems we solve daily.

Window AC Not Cooling

The most common complaint. This could be due to low refrigerant, a dirty filter, or a compressor issue. We diagnose and fix it fast.

Starts at ₹399 Get Quote

Window AC Making Noise Repair

Rattling, buzzing, or grinding sounds can indicate a loose part or a failing motor. We’ll silence the problem and restore peace.

Starts at ₹299 Get Quote

Window AC Water Leakage Solution

Water dripping inside your room? It’s likely a clogged drain line. We provide a quick and clean window AC water leakage solution.

Starts at ₹349 Get Quote

Window AC PCB Repair

If your AC is unresponsive, the electronic control board (PCB) might be faulty. We specialize in complex AC PCB repair.

Inspection at ₹350 Get Quote

Window AC Gas Filling

Poor cooling is often a sign of low refrigerant. We offer safe and efficient AC gas filling with a leak test.

Starts at ₹2500 Get Quote

Complete Window AC Service

Boost efficiency and air quality with our comprehensive service, including filter cleaning, coil washing, and system checks.

Starts at ₹499 Get Quote
